principle: A civilization is a persistent network of populations, cultures, institutions, settlements, technology and relationships—not a single species label.
rules: Civilization may be single-species or multi-species.
Species identity does not determine political alignment.
Technology level constrains available infrastructure, ships, medicine, communications and detectable signatures.
Government/institutions may change while civilization identity/history persists.
First Contact status is observer/relationship specific and may differ by faction.
Pre-warp and protected-contact rules constrain Starfleet actions when applicable.
Civilization history after campaign start evolves from campaign events.
